title: Within the 2025 neighborhood pilot's limits
note: Nothing on the four bounding streets or at their intersections, and only temporary measures: no speed humps and no traffic circles. Filters, diverters, turn bans, one-way streets, stop control and speed limits are treated as temporary, which is an assumption. Traffic moved onto the bounding streets is not counted as harm.

title: Without those limits
note: Every tool except new traffic lights, anywhere in the area. Shown for comparison.
